To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a multilayer coating approach is essential for highly efficient and reliable DNA separations by MCE.
the multilayer coating with 2-(PEOGNP)-PVP-PEO(GNP), which is easy to fill, is essential to minimize interaction of DNA with the PMMA surface and to achieve high efficiency.

dynamic coating of the PMMAMCE microchannel with PEO, followed by multilayer coating with PEO and PVP containing gold nanoparticles, provides a highly efficient separation of DNA markers and hsp65 gene fragment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a highly efficient and reproducible MCE method using dynamic coating of PMMA microchannels for the separation of double-stranded (ds) DNA.
the modification of the PMMA surface for the separation of double-stranded DNAs by MCE.
the dynamic coating of PMMA microchannels and its application to the highly efficient separation of DNA by MCE.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamic coating of microchannels with PVP and PEO containing GNP on the first layer of PEO is essential to achieve highly efficient and reproducible DNA separations by MCE.
the coating of the microchannel with PEO(Mw = 6.00 x 10(4)) is essential to minimize nonspecific interaction between DNA and the PMMA surface.

the coating of PMMA microchannels is essential for DNA separation by MCE and the multilayer coating with PEO, 5.0 wt % PVP, and 0.75 wt % PEO(GNP)-containing solution is the most effective for DNA separation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the multilayer coating with PEO, PV, and PEO(GNP)-containing polymer on PMMA chip is a promising approach for DNA separation by MCE.

dynamic coating of the PMMa microchannel with 1.5% PEO and PVP is necessary for DNA separations, and the coating of the PVP with PEO(GNP)(0.75%) is sufficient to provide high efficiency and reproducibility of the separation of DNA fragments.

the coating of microchannels with PVP is necessary to achieve the dynamic coating of PMMA microchannels and that the dynamic coating of the multilayered PMMA chips with the PEO(GNP)-containing solution is essential to achieve high efficiency for the electrophoresis of DNA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of PEO(GNP)-coated PMMA microchannel chips can be used to separate DNA fragments of various lengths with high efficiency and reproducibility.
dynamic coating of the PM-MA microchannels is an effective method to improve the efficiency of DNA separation by MCE.
dynamic coating with 0.5-0.75% polymer solutions is essential to achieve a high efficiency for the separation of dsDNA by MCE.
